thread:
emma (Revenue Ops): Heads up — reconciliation flagged a $24,375 gap in April deferred schedule tied to StratusGrid vendor invoice INV-SG-412. Looks like a pricing experiment promo was applied to vendor-billed committed hosting and the billing pipeline reduced revenue instead of creating deferred prepay. Tagging tony + nina.

acct-bot: Vendor invoice received: INV-SG-412 (StratusGrid). Amount: $24,375. Posted 2026-04-02 10:05 UTC.

tony (Billing): I pulled the billing event. The experiment set "promo=true" for a subset of commits; our mapping currently treats promo -> contra_revenue. For StratusGrid vendor prepayments we should map to prepaid_hosting. System auto-posted a contra of $3,650 this draft run.

nina (Controller): Is that already in GL? If so we need reversing JE + establishing deferral. Provide invoice PDF, mapping snapshot, and recommended entries.

emma (Revenue Ops): Not posted to finalized GL yet, in draft. Proposed quick fix: reverse the contra and record full deferred balance amortized per contract (8-month term according to contract SG-77). Example entries:

Journal A (reverse draft posting)
Dr Contra-Revenue 3,650
Cr Accounts Payable 3,650
Memo: Reverse auto-applied contra for INV-SG-412 (mis-map)
\Journal B (establish deferred balance)
Dr Accounts Payable 24,375
Cr Deferred Revenue 24,375
Memo: Record prepaid hosting (StratusGrid INV-SG-412) amort 8 months

tony (Billing): I'll attach the invoice and export to WP-INV-SG-412 and open a mapping PR to change promo->prepaid_hosting for vendor=StratusGrid when sku contains "commit". PR link will be in the workpaper.

nina (Controller): For audit I need: invoice PDF, billing event CSV, ratecard snapshot effective at billing time, and contract confirming 8-month term. Also want a one-line rationale documenting why this is deferred (vendor-billed prepay tied to future hosting).

emma (Revenue Ops): Uploads: https://files.redwood/INV-SG-412.pdf, billing export: https://files.redwood/billing/sg-412-export.csv, ratecard snapshot: https://docs.redwood/pricing/ratecard-2026-04-01, contract: SG-77 (8-month). Added a short root-cause note: "experiment promo flag leaked into vendor invoice generator, mapping rules unchanged."

ton y (Billing): PR created: https://git.redwood/billing/pulls/241 (mapping fix). Workpaper created: WP-INV-SG-412-reclass.

carlos (CFO): Reviewed summary. Approve the reversing JE + deferral establishment for this close. Please route workpaper + JE template to accounting@redwood.com and cc me. Also add a controls ticket to ensure experiment toggles are validated against vendor mapping rules during billing cutoffs.

nina (Controller): Approve contingent on attachments received (confirmed). I'll sign and post the JE before EOD close and update the deferred revenue schedule.

emma (Revenue Ops): Thanks — running a 90-day search for StratusGrid invoices with promo flags and will post results to the workpaper. If anyone spots other vendors with similar mis-tags, drop them here.

tony (Billing): Quick query shows INV-SG-398 and INV-SG-405 are fine; only 412 had the promo flag in today's draft. Will include query output in WP.

emma (Revenue Ops): Closing loop. After JE posts I'll update the close pack and add the control to the quarter plan. :white_check_mark:
